decisions.reason: As the modular continuation of an already proven trommel concept that has remained in the portfolio for several years, it now looks like a validated offering with little reason for near-term withdrawal.
A multi-model mobile flail shredder line fits the firm's core mobile processing business, and survival beyond the launch phase suggests enough market acceptance to keep the option active.

Although more segment-specific, the green-waste mobile grinder serves a clear niche in the firm's customer base and its continued presence indicates sufficient value to retain it rather than abandon it now.

The stationary single-shaft pre-shredder line complements the firm's broader waste-processing portfolio, and after several years on the market it is unlikely to be dropped unless portfolio simplification becomes necessary.
